Compete with others to create the coziest, happiest space for your cat and win their eternal contentment – or at least their grudging approval. 
Buy new tiles for your deck to expand your cat's apartment and make attractive combos. Move your cat to take advantage of attractions, collect points for doing so, and use the best combinations between attractions. Manage your deck wisely.

—description from the publisher
community_text:
[Rating: 4/10] This is a novel combination of several mechanisms that I'm tired of. And nothing in the materials or gameplay seems to require that cats be portrayed as spoiled jerks, as they are in the rulebook, so I wonder what happened there.  [1 play]

[Rating: 6/10] Better than I thought it would be from the initial glance, with another cat themed game, and cartoonish art, I almost wrote this one off. It just makes the game seem more playful with not as much strategy, but there is a strategic game in here. The game revolves around scoring tiles from placing them in manners to maximize points, which is not all that different from other tile games. Something I like about this one is purchasing other tiles in a deck building manner.  The interaction between players is minimal, just competing for goals. Overall, in the middle on this one.
